answer.book: A single Latin polemical treatise by Crell on the Eucharist against Gregorius de Valentia (1586), built as a title page, a dedication to Petrus Beutrichius, a preface, the disputation itself, and a closing errata list, with no numbered divisions visible on the sheet.
